note: Three kinds of post. Money and daily life (Monday and Friday, and most news posts): prices, levies, fees, jobs, scams, in plain words. Kenya's pride (Tuesday: Kenya at its best; Saturday: Built in Kenya). Accountability (Wednesday: Promise Tracker or the Chapter Six Test; the daily news posts), with sources and a clear demand. Two polls a week (Thursday and Sunday). Two news posts every day: lunchtime and evening.

campus.voice: Clear, well-informed Kenyan English for students: fees, HELB, internships, first jobs. Complete sentences, no slang fillers.

young_pro.who: Young professionals in their first jobs
young_pro.voice: Sharp, plain Kenyan English for young professionals: pay, levies, taxes, careers, money decisions.

creator.voice: Plain, current Kenyan English for creators: platforms, rights, earnings, tools.

hustle.voice: Practical Kenyan English for small business owners: licences, taxes, M-Pesa tills, county fees.

techie.voice: Precise and plain: how systems and public tech actually work, without gatekeeping.

diaspora.who: Young Africans abroad and friends on other continents
diaspora.voice: Kenyan English that explains local terms: what is changing at home, investments, places, progress.

everyone.voice: Simple, informed Kenyan English anyone can follow.

whatsapp_channel.how: Forward the approved image + caption from Telegram. WhatsApp Channels have no public posting API.

tiktok_reels.how: Weekly: turn the Kesho Kutwa carousel into a 30s slideshow with voice-over (script generated).

radio.how: Weekly 2-minute community radio segment (script generated) for people without smartphones.

sms.how: Optional: weekly Usiibiwe tip by SMS to opted-in subscribers via Africa's Talking (script generated, max 160 chars).
